about.title: Background, education & skills
paragraphs: I'm Kalid Muhumed, a fullstack developer focused on automation. I build web apps in Next.js and connect them with Python services, APIs, and webhooks so manual steps become reliable flows.
Whether it's a dashboard, a lead pipeline, or a nightly sync between systems, I want the result to feel simple for the user and solid under the hood.
Right now I'm working on projects where interfaces, data, and automated workflows meet, from prototype to something you can trust in production.

privacy.title: Privacy & data handling
privacy.intro: We value your privacy and keep data collection to a minimum. Here is a clear overview of how we handle the information you share with us.
privacy.collectBody: When you contact us or send a quote request through the form, we collect your name, email address, and message. To protect the system from spam, our form service (Web3Forms) is used.
privacy.useBody: Your details are used only so we can read your request, consider your proposal, and reply. The information is delivered directly to our email. We never use your details for automated marketing, newsletters, or similar, and we do not share your data with third parties.
privacy.controlBody: You can always ask us to delete your information. If you want us to remove your quote request and contact details from our systems, send a message to kalid.automations@gmail.com and we will delete the email right away.
